title: AI Video Content Creator
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
We're hiring an AI Video Content Creator to support our growing creative needs. This is a unique opportunity for someone with a passion for design, video, and emerging AI tools. You'll use AI platforms to turn ideas and images into compelling video content, supporting the development of Created AI.

We're specifically looking for individuals with a video editing background. What matters most is a passion for AI, a problem-solving mindset, and a fast internet connection.
key_responsibilities:
- Use AI tools to generate high-quality images and video assets based on creative briefs
- Edit content using tools like Adobe Premiere and CapCut
- Support the video editing team with asset generation (image-first, then video)
- Learn and adapt quickly to new AI software and creative technologies
- Collaborate with creative leads to meet deadlines and output volume
- Organize and manage creative files efficiently
- Basic familiarity with graphic design or video editing (schoolwork, personal projects, or portfolio accepted)
- Comfort using or learning AI tools like Runway, Midjourney, Sora, ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling, etc.
- Strong internet connection (essential for uploading and using AI platforms)
- Eagerness to learn and take feedback
- A portfolio (can include personal, school, or AI-generated work)
- Must complete a short test assignment if selected
- Fully remote
- Observed Local Holidays
- Paid training and access to learning resources
- Work with a supportive, innovative, and fast-moving global team

Created AI is the platform where AI video ads get made, launched, and measured in one place. About the Role
We're hiring an AI Video Content Creator to support our growing creative needs. This is a unique opportunity for someone with a passion for design, video, and emerging AI tools. You'll use AI platforms to turn ideas and images into compelling video content, supporting the development of Created AI.

We're specifically looking for individuals with a video editing background. What matters most is a passion for AI, a problem-solving mindset, and a fast internet connection.

Responsibilities

- Use AI tools to generate high-quality images and video assets based on creative briefs
- Edit content using tools like Adobe Premiere and CapCut
- Support the video editing team with asset generation (image-first, then video)
- Learn and adapt quickly to new AI software and creative technologies
- Collaborate with creative leads to meet deadlines and output volume
- Organize and manage creative files efficiently
- Basic familiarity with graphic design or video editing (schoolwork, personal projects, or portfolio accepted)
- Comfort using or learning AI tools like Runway, Midjourney, Sora, ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling, etc.
- Strong internet connection (essential for uploading and using AI platforms)
- Eagerness to learn and take feedback
- A portfolio (can include personal, school, or AI-generated work)
- Must complete a short test assignment if selected
- Fully remote
- Observed Local Holidays
- Paid training and access to learning resources
- Work with a supportive, innovative, and fast-moving global team
